checks.name: 52-card deck with four suits
checks.detail: makeDeck(seed) returns exactly 52 unique cards: 4 suits × 13 ranks (A,2..10,J,Q,K).

checks.name: initial deal uses 28 tableau cards and 24 stock cards
checks.detail: Columns hold 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 cards (28); the remaining 24 form the face-down stock.

checks.name: standard poker card proportions
checks.detail: Rendered cards use a 63×88mm aspect ratio (0.716); the mobile board keeps seven equal columns at 390×844 and 320×568.

checks.name: tableau builds descending in alternating colours
checks.detail: canPlaceOnTableau/isValidRun require rank −1 and opposite colours; only face-up runs may move.

checks.name: empty tableau columns accept a King only
checks.detail: canPlaceOnTableau(empty, cards) returns true only when cards[0].value === 13.

checks.name: foundations build A to K in one suit
checks.detail: Each foundation is bound to one suit index and accepts A first, then strictly +1 up to K; mixing suits or skipping ranks is rejected.

checks.name: draw 1 / draw 3 and unlimited recycle
checks.detail: Draw moves min(drawMode, stock) cards face up to the waste; recycling reverses the waste face down. Draw-3 recycling costs 20 points, draw-1 costs 0.

checks.name: auto-flip and win detection
checks.detail: Removing cards from a tableau column flips the newly exposed top card; the game status becomes won when all four foundations hold 13 cards.

checks.name: red/black suit identities
checks.detail: Hearts and diamonds are red; spades and clubs are black. Colours drive tableau legality, not just presentation.

checks.name: local material photography
checks.detail: The page uses local felt.webp, card-back.webp and card-paper.webp; card ranks and pips are code-rendered SVG, not AI images or emoji.

checks.name: card conservation
checks.detail: Every state holds exactly 52 unique cards across stock, waste, four foundations and seven tableau columns; serialize/deserialize rejects duplicates or missing cards.
